name: Pre-Columbian Era
description: Indigenous civilizations such as the Muisca, Tayrona, and Quimbaya flourish in what is now Colombia.

name: Spanish Conquest
description: Spanish explorer Gonzalo Jiménez de Quesada founds the city of Santa Fe de Bogotá, marking the beginning of Spanish colonization.

name: Independence from Spain
description: Colombia declares independence from Spain, along with other South American countries, led by Simón Bolívar.

name: Gran Colombia
description: Gran Colombia is formed, including modern-day Colombia, Ecuador, Panama, and Venezuela, with Simón Bolívar as its president.

name: The Thousand Days' War
description: A civil war breaks out between liberals and conservatives, resulting in significant political and social unrest in Colombia.

name: La Violencia
description: A period of political violence and unrest begins in Colombia, lasting for approximately ten years.

name: Founding of FARC
description: The Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) is founded as a communist guerrilla group advocating for land reform and social equality.

name: Peace Agreement with FARC
description: After years of negotiations, the Colombian government signs a historic peace agreement with the FARC, marking the end of the armed conflict.

name: Presidential Election of Iván Duque
description: Iván Duque is elected as the 60th President of Colombia, succeeding Juan Manuel Santos.

name: Current Era
description: Colombia continues to work towards peace, economic growth, and social development.
